notes.title: Error 404 Header Not Found
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653549/3a2e4d51e0e9a2571ae695cc02845c62edeb5b95.png[/img]

[h3]Dear Eye Life future employees, [/h3]

We have been tricked! Sabotaged from within! Employee [REDACTED], formerly a member of the Flat Eye systems and maintenance division, was foolish enough to use our MemoryService Module without proper supervision. This has resulted in crucial time being lost for the finalized development of Flat Eye. With the ContinuityUnwinder still in development, we can not rely on time travel to solve the issue. 

This means that our grand opening on October 17th has been postponed by a little over 4 weeks as we catch up on the polish and finetuning [REDACTED] forgot. We could not allow the Flat Eye system accidentally causing harm to our customers (employees come secondary). 

We expect you to gain access to your station on November 14th. We will keep the Flat Eye demo simulation up and running until the doors fly open, as small compensation. Please stay tuned, and we appreciate your patience. 

[h3]- Eye Life Upper Management
[/h3]

notes.title: Flat Eye Modules | ToiletSmart
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41653549/5a7f5f9c715886be244cd76a6654de4b5ae69440.png[/img]

[h1]Introducing ToiletSmart![/h1]

It’s just a simple truth of nature that toilets are a must at any station, whether in the past, present or future. While the simple toilets are effectively remnants of the old world, with time, patience, and collecting the right amount of resources, you can upgrade them to the ToiletSmart. 


As far as technology goes, ToiletSmart are as quiet as they are intricate. In fact, Customers use them with no knowledge of the sophisticated amount of data and matter stored by EyeLife. In a flush, the company find out about the health, the habits, and the future of the Customer. 

[i][h3]Flat Eye - Number 1 for your Number 2.
[/h3][/i]

[h2]Introducing the CashSmart!

The center point for the entire Flat Eye station when you are just starting off, the CashRegister does exactly what you would expect - it scans simple items for purchase. Except it breaks… a lot. And Customers generally don’t like that.

Once you’ve accumulated enough money, you can even replace it with its more reliable upgraded version - the CashSmart, which works by itself, utilizes a simple-to-understand touch screen, and puts the power of the purchase into the Customers hands.

notes.title: Flat Eye is a management game about the dark side of tech
notes.content:
The expo floor at GDC this year was a bit sparser than usual - and no surprise, as this was one of the first in-person industry events since the initial COVID-19 outbreak led to two years of virtual meetings and working from home. But one game we did get to look at during this year's show was Flat Eye, a management game that goes small on scope but big on narrative. It's about the way new technology enters our lives nowadays - usually offering some free convenience while gathering data for purposes we can only guess at.

On its face, Flat Eye is a simple enough game. You're the newly hired and sole attendant at a fuel station somewhere in Scandinavia, and it's your job to take care of your customers by providing them with the latest and greatest in convenience tech. Starting with clean energy generation and a couple simple shelving units, you'll gradually add self check-out aisles and nicer restrooms.

Things get a bit sinister, however, when you build your first AI-driven surgery suite, which can patch patients up after trauma but also offer enhanced lifespans to select customers. All of this is governed by an artificial intelligence - that's the eponymous Flat Eye - who has their own goals and motivations, and access to a hell of a lot more data than you do.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Flat Eye | Opening in 2022
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to the Flat Eye™ Team!
[/h1]

We’re looking forward to welcoming you to your very own Flat Eye™ gas station this year.

As the manager of a single Flat Eye™ location, you will optimize your products and services based on the Flat Eye™ intuitive shopping algorithms. Upgrade your store to better serve your loyal customers and unlock narrative paths along the way. 

[previewyoutube=Lh3qqeoPsv0;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Flat Eye is a management sim with an emphasis on the stories told through returning customers. These stories touch on humanity’s increasing reliance on technological advances and digital privacy, spanning from the absurd and comical to the eye-opening and unnerving. 
[/i]
